attributes.source: GWSA obtained from subtraction of observational (Gaussian) filtered of aggregated SWE, Glacier, RZSM, and SWS (Lisflood) from GRACE-TWSA (0.5-degree).
attributes.institution: GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences https://www.gfz-potsdam.de/en/home/
attributes.title: This product is assigned as the version V1.12 of groundwater storage anomaly derived from the G3P (The Global Gravity-based Groundwater Product) project; www.g3p.eu
attributes.funding: This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement nº 870353.
attributes.NCO: netCDF Operators version 5.0.6 (Homepage = http://nco.sf.net, Code = http://github.com/nco/nco)

gwsa.description: GWSA obtained from subtraction of optimal (Gaussian) filter of sum of all WSCs (SWE + SWS + RZSM + Glaciers) filter width 250-km), from the GRACE-TWSA (0.5-degree).
gwsa.anomaly_definition: The anomaly has been calculated for the gridded water storage data sets by subtracting the mean storage value (period 2002-04 to 2020-12) from each absolute value of every time step in each individual grid cell.

uncertainty.description: GWSA uncertainty obtained by using the error propogation approach (sqrt(TWS**2 + SWE**2 + SWS**2 + RZSM**2 + Glacier**2)
